title: Energy and Sound
seo_title: Grade 4 Natural Sciences and Technology: Energy and Sound Worksheets (CAPS)
standard_code: Grade 4 Natural Sciences and Technology: Energy and sound
standard_text: Sound is made when things vibrate. Sound energy travels through solids, liquids and gases to our ears. Sounds can be loud or soft and high or low; musical instruments make sound in different ways. (summary of CAPS Natural Sciences and Technology, Grade 4, Energy and Change: Energy and sound)
meta_desc: Free Grade 4 Natural Sciences and Technology worksheets (CAPS): vibrations, how sound travels, loud and soft, high and low sounds, and musical instruments. 100 questions with answers.
key_sub: Sound travels through solids, liquids and gases, but not through empty space.
body_html:
How to think about it

Every sound is made by something vibrating: a guitar string, a drum skin or your vocal cords. The vibrations pass through the air (or water, or a solid) to your ears.

A bigger vibration makes a louder sound. Faster vibrations make a higher pitch: a short or tight string gives a higher note than a long or loose one. Sound cannot travel through space, where there is no air.

Example

What makes the sound when you hit a drum?

Watch the drum skin.

Answer: the drum skin vibrating

Example

A guitar string is made shorter. What happens to the note?

Shorter vibrates faster.

Answer: it gets higher

Common mistakes

  • Mixing up loudness and pitch.
  • Thinking sound travels in space.
  • Thinking only big things vibrate.
